reason: The official 10-minute workbook contains every timestamp from 02:00 through 02:50 on 31 March 2019 and then 03:00. Interpreting the Excel serials as Europe/Berlin civil time creates duplicate UTC instants. The source clock is fixed CET (UTC+1). This is demonstrable from source timestamps without examining target residuals.

corrected_fields.time_zone: Etc/GMT-1 fixed UTC+1/CET with no daylight-saving transition

source_quality_findings_before_scoring: One conflicting duplicate N2 full1 timestamp occurs at 2019-03-18T18:10:00+01:00, before the scored period; the earlier row is dropped and the event is reported.
Outdoor CO2 is missing for four primary-period 10-minute rows. A labeled carry-forward permits thermal-only diagnostics, but the strict no-missing-input gate remains failed.
scientific_label: The target archive was opened after v1 was committed and pushed. Because loader corrections were then required, results under v1.1 are a predeclared holdout evaluation with a documented post-unsealing source correction, not pristine blind-validation evidence.
